system.description:
• Effect: Gain the Physical Change granted by your Patron. It is permanent and visible, and gives you a natural weapon (claws unless your Patron says otherwise; 1d6, lethal).
  • Its once-a-day power spends your Curse for the day: each day you lay the Curse or use the power, not both (both from 15th). It takes your action and uses your Class Save DC unless it says otherwise.
